business: Clinical-stage biopharma developing NBD1-stabilizer CFTR modulators for cystic fibrosis (CF), targeting F508del, the most common CF mutation. Formerly Sling Therapeutics; incorporated 2019; HQ Waltham, MA; ~59 employees. No approved products, no revenue.
pipeline: SION-719 (NBD1 stabilizer): Phase 2a PreciSION CF (add-on to Trikafta) FAILED key endpoint Aug 10 2026; NOT advancing as add-on to SOC
SION-451 (NBD1 stabilizer): Phase 1 dual-combination (with SION-2222 / SION-109) completed; SION-451 + SION-2222 preferred combo; company evaluating next steps

key_events.aug_10_2026: PreciSION CF Phase 2a (N=15 adults homozygous F508del on stable Trikafta; SION-719 add-on 14 days) missed key activity endpoint: -1.0 mmol/L mean placebo-adjusted sweat chloride change (p=0.7). Confounders observed (high inter-individual sweat-Cl variability; Trikafta exposure differences between periods) being evaluated. SION-719 generally well tolerated. Company not advancing SION-719 as add-on to SOC. Also reported Phase 1 dual-combo data: SION-451 + SION-2222 preferred; safety/PK objectives met.
key_events.aug_10_2026_cash: Ended Q2 with ~$268.3M cash; 'plans to take actions to preserve capital while evaluating next steps' (post-failure language change)
key_events.aug_6_2026: Q2 2026 results: $268.3M cash; pre-failure guidance said cash funds operations into 2028

competitive_context: CF modulator market dominated by Vertex Pharmaceuticals (Trikafta standard of care; Vertex CF franchise ~$10B+/yr). F508del is the most common CF mutation (~90% of CF patients carry at least one copy; roughly half are homozygous). Sionna thesis: directly stabilizing NBD1 could restore near-normal CFTR function. After the SION-719 add-on failure, the standalone SION-451 dual-combo path would compete directly against Vertex's Trikafta - a much higher bar. Multiple prior CF challengers have failed against Vertex.
